name: Steamed Asparagus (Tender Tips Only — Discard Woody Stems)
whyItWorks: The delicate top 2 inches (tips) of asparagus spears are tender and low in tough woody lignin fiber, providing prebiotic inulin and folate in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Snap spears to discard the bottom half entirely. Steam the upper tips until completely tender. Chew well.
watchOuts: Stricture hazard: Never eat the lower woody fibrous asparagus stalks! They are stringy and resist digestion.
